the Town has prepared the attached requested conditions for consideration by Eversource and the EFSB. The Town recognizes the current process largely concerns exemptions pursuant to the Zoning Act to construct the substation expansion, as the question of whether there should be an expansion at all was previously approved in the DPU proceeding. As such, the Town has drafted the attached conditions with an eye toward construction management. The language in the document came from the Town – the Town asked its boards and officials to generate relevant conditions, compiled the results, and prepared the attached. Submitted on 05-24-2026.
